officialText:
Every certificate of occupancy or temporary certificate of occupancy issued for a basement or cellar apartment in a one- or two-family home created or altered pursuant to this article must contain a reference to this article. A partial or amended certificate of occupancy or a temporary certificate of occupancy issued pursuant to section 28-507.6 must contain a note that such certificate of occupancy does not certify compliance with applicable laws with respect to parts of the building outside of the apartment created or altered pursuant to this article.

(L.L. 2024/126, 12/18/2024, eff. 6/16/2025)
